s1.syndrome_frame: Progressive painful skin lesions and ulcers with systemic symptoms and laboratory abnormalities
salient_findings: Progressive, painful blisters and ulcers of the groin
Enlargement of the tongue with difficulty with mastication
Numbness without weakness of the distal lower limbs
key_facts: 1-week history of progressive, painful blisters and ulcers of the groin
3-month history of tongue enlargement leading to difficulty with mastication
3-month history of numbness without weakness of the distal lower limbs
History of IgG λ-type multiple myeloma complicated by anemia and lytic lesions in the calvarium
Patient is taking folic acid and intramuscular cyanocobalamin supplements due to deficiencies
Circinate purpuric patches with erosions on the natal cleft, buttocks, inguinal creases, and vulva
Hemorrhagic flaccid bullae on the posterior perineum
Macroglossia, glossitis, and a hemorrhagic erosion on the hard palate
Purpuric macules present periorbitally, on the lips, inframammary folds, forearms, and thighs
Low serum zinc level
Subepidermal blister lined by fibrin and chronic inflammatory infiltrate with scattered short eosinophilic bands in the dermis
Apple-green birefringence on polarized light microscopy with Congo red staining

shortlist.label: Amyloidosis
shortlist.why_kept: Apple-green birefringence on polarized light microscopy with Congo red staining and history of multiple myeloma

shortlist.label: Multiple myeloma-associated amyloidosis
shortlist.why_kept: History of IgG λ-type multiple myeloma and systemic symptoms

shortlist.label: Paraneoplastic pemphigus
shortlist.why_kept: Progressive painful blisters and ulcers with history of multiple myeloma

shortlist.label: Scurvy
shortlist.why_kept: Low serum zinc level and presence of purpuric macules and hemorrhagic bullae

shortlist.label: Zinc deficiency
shortlist.why_kept: Low serum zinc level and presence of skin lesions and ulcers

raw.rationale: The patient's presentation of painful blisters and ulcers, purpuric patches, and hemorrhagic bullae, along with the low serum zinc level and the presence of subepidermal blisters with fibrin and chronic inflammatory infiltrate, is consistent with scurvy. Additionally, the patient's history of dietary deficiencies and the presence of glossitis and macroglossia further support this diagnosis.

rejected.label: Amyloidosis
rejected.why: While the patient has a history of multiple myeloma, the biopsy findings of subepidermal blisters and the presence of apple-green birefringence on polarized light microscopy with Congo red staining are not typical of amyloidosis.

rejected.label: Multiple myeloma-associated amyloidosis
rejected.why: The patient's symptoms and biopsy findings are not consistent with amyloidosis, and the presence of low serum zinc level and subepidermal blisters suggest a different diagnosis.

rejected.label: Paraneoplastic pemphigus
rejected.why: The patient's presentation and biopsy findings do not support a diagnosis of paraneoplastic pemphigus, which is typically associated with autoantibodies against epithelial antigens.

rejected.label: Zinc deficiency
rejected.why: While the patient has a low serum zinc level, the clinical presentation and biopsy findings are more consistent with scurvy, which is caused by vitamin C deficiency.

rejected.label: Multiple myeloma
rejected.why: The patient's symptoms and biopsy findings are not consistent with multiple myeloma, and the presence of low serum zinc level and subepidermal blisters suggest a different diagnosis.
